fallback.title: 当座舱 AI 帮不上忙：从失败话术到任务恢复
fallback.summary: 结合5个受测版本的全量表现与30个失败案例，研究失败反馈、接管指引与任务恢复。
findings: 失败反馈的价值，在于帮助用户继续推进任务，而不只是说明“暂时做不到”。
报告区分能力解释、手动指引、界面接管与恢复路径，指出不同兜底方式的体验差异。
现有记录支持行为分析；是否真正恢复并完成任务，需要后续实测验证。

en.title: When Cockpit AI Fails: Helping the User Recover
en.summary: What should a voice assistant do when it cannot finish a task? We examine 30 real test records to distinguish an explanation from a useful next step.
findings: A good failure response helps the user move forward. Simply saying why a request failed is rarely enough.
The study separates four responses: explaining a limitation, guiding manual action, handing off to an interface and offering a recovery path.
These records show how systems respond to failure. Further testing is needed to establish whether the proposed recovery actually leads to task completion.

zeekr9x.title: 极氪 9X 座舱 AI 专题报告
zeekr9x.summary: 基于855条 BeeEVAL 记录，分析极氪9X六域表现、场景成绩、行业样本对标与改进优先级。
outline: 六域画像与细分场景成绩
改进优先级与复杂性分析
findings: 知识与出行形成相对优势，车控兑现仍是优先改进项。
路线规划与车书知识表现较强，车控对象修正和补能条件筛选存在差距。
结合六域画像、行业样本与真实案例，明确产品亮点和改进优先级。
zeekr9x.scope: 数据截至2026-10-07；按各受测版本全量记录统计，专项采用对应领域或场景的全部记录。

en.title: ZEEKR 9X: A Closer Look at Cockpit AI
en.summary: A review of 855 BeeEVAL records, comparing six domains, real task performance and industry benchmarks to identify where ZEEKR should focus next.
findings: Vehicle knowledge and travel assistance are relative strengths. Dependable vehicle control remains an important area for improvement.
The system performs better on route planning and vehicle questions than on corrected control requests or charging searches with specific constraints.
Domain scores, industry comparisons and individual test cases together show where the product leads and which gaps deserve attention first.

l9livis.title: 理想 L9 Livis 座舱 AI 单车专题报告
l9livis.summary: 基于889条 BeeEVAL 记录，分析常用任务的兑现基础、六域表现及动态信息与生成能力边界。
outline: 行业样本对标与产品亮点
改口、动态数据与能力边界
findings: 常用用车任务具备较好的兑现基础，动态信息与生成能力仍有明确边界。
车书知识、组合操作与使用指导是优势，改口和动态服务需要进一步完善。
总体分数之外，报告拆解六域与细分场景，区分常用任务优势和完整能力范围。
l9livis.scope: 数据截至2026-10-07；按各受测版本全量记录统计，专项采用对应领域或场景的全部记录。

en.title: Li Auto L9 Livis: A Closer Look at Cockpit AI
en.summary: How well does the L9 Livis handle everyday requests? 889 BeeEVAL records reveal its strengths across six domains, along with the limits of live information and content generation.
findings: The system handles many everyday tasks well. Requests involving live information or generated content expose clearer limits.
Vehicle knowledge, combined actions and usage guidance stand out. Correcting a request and completing tasks through live services remain areas to improve.
The headline score tells only part of the story. Domain and scenario results show which strengths hold up in everyday use and where they stop.

travel.title: 蔚来出行 AI 专项对标与改进建议
travel.summary: 围绕目的地、路线与补能，分析蔚来 ET5 出行任务的体验差距。
findings: 出行体验的关键，是从“回答问题”走向“完成任务”。
ET5的差距集中在多目的地、条件修正、口语需求与目的地串联。
报告按任务选择可学习的标杆，将理解、任务状态和服务连接转化为改进方向。
outline: 典型案例与任务链诊断

en.title: NIO ET5: Where Travel Assistance Falls Short
en.summary: From finding a destination to planning a route and charging along the way, we examine where the NIO ET5 travel experience breaks down and what stronger systems do differently.
findings: Travel assistance must complete the journey-related task, not just answer the question.
The ET5 struggles particularly with multiple stops, changing conditions, conversational requests and the order of destinations.
Task-level benchmarks point to specific improvements in request understanding, task state and connected services.

multi-stop.title: 多点行程规划：品牌对标与产品启示
multi-stop.summary: 比较多品牌的多点行程规划表现，结合典型案例分析任务机制、执行差距与可复制的产品改进。
outline: 四类规划任务与六个典型案例
可复制的任务机制与产品改进
findings: 极氪是优先学习对象，银河的执行表现也值得重点研究。
多点规划的难度来自顺序、约束和任务衔接，不能只用站点数量衡量。
通过典型案例提炼可复制的规划与执行机制，而不止比较品牌排名。
multi-stop.scope: 数据截至2026-10-07；按各受测版本全量记录统计，专项采用对应领域或场景的全部记录。

en.title: Multi-stop Route Planning: What the Best Systems Get Right
en.summary: Compare how brands plan and execute trips with multiple stops. Real cases reveal what preserves the route, respects constraints and keeps a task moving.
findings: ZEEKR is a useful benchmark for deeper study. Galaxy also warrants attention for its execution performance.
The hard part is more than counting stops: a system must preserve order, respect constraints and maintain the task across a conversation.
Representative cases reveal planning and execution patterns that product teams can learn from, beyond the brand rankings.

i8-livis.title: 理想 i8 → L9 Livis 座舱 AI 能力变化报告
i8-livis.summary: 比较 i8 与 L9 Livis 的跨车型、跨期测试表现，区分任务能力增强、功能取消与小样本波动，分析产品取舍和持续短板。
outline: 总体变化与同类任务比较
能力增强、功能取舍与测试波动
技术链路、用户体验与验证建议
findings: Livis阶段总体表现改善，但局部变化需要分别审视。
多地点与组合任务组织增强，图像生成取消属于功能范围取舍。
小样本比例波动不等于能力退化；持续短板与明确功能取消应分别验证。

en.title: From Li Auto i8 to L9 Livis: What Changed?
en.summary: A comparison across two vehicles and collection periods. We separate stronger capabilities, removed features and small-sample variation to understand the product choices behind the results.
findings: Aggregate performance is stronger in the Livis sample. Individual changes still need to be examined on their own terms.
Multi-stop planning and combined task handling improve. The removal of image generation reflects a change in product scope.
A small-sample dip does not establish a regression. Persistent gaps and explicitly removed features need separate interpretation and validation.
